about: Warm-up hoodie (basketball-hoodie.glb, HOODIE/MODELQ6 2026-11-20, first version): parts per triangle from the model's own seams: its sleeves the Sleeve stripe colour (the tile look's cyan; else the print), the hood's inside the Lining colour (else Secondary), its rib cuffs and hem bands the Rib colour (else Main), its zip the Zip colour (else Secondary); everything else the print.
